name: LifeBench
intro: LifeBench 是一个面向长时程多源记忆的代理评测基准，要求模型在长期事件轨迹中综合陈述性与非陈述性记忆，并基于真实世界先验完成跨来源、跨时间的检索与推理。
build_method: 真实世界先验注入, 认知科学启发的长时程事件模拟, 部分层次事件组织
task_type: Agent任务, 长文本推理, 记忆检索
eval_feature: 长期记忆, 多源信息整合, 时序演化
scale: 2003个问题, 平均上下文深度3.66M tokens
intro_en: LifeBench evaluates long-horizon multi-source memory for agents by combining declarative and non-declarative memory reasoning over dense life-event simulations.
build_method_en: Real-world priors, cognitive-science-inspired long-horizon event simulation, partonomic event structuring
task_type_en: Agent Task, Long-context Reasoning, Memory Retrieval
eval_feature_en: Long-horizon Memory, Multi-source Integration, Temporal Evolution

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2603.03781v1, Sections 3–5. LifeBench uses five DeepSeek-R1 modules for persona synthesis, hierarchical outline planning, daily activity simulation, phone-data generation, and QA generation. Survey and PersonaHub priors, a 20–30-person social graph, and real AMap locations ground each persona; up to 10 plots from about 50 candidates are decomposed into sub-day atomic events. Subjective and objective agents combine long/short-term memory with schedule, travel, venue, weather, and factual constraints. The release contains 10 one-year lives, 5,149 events and 8,046 phone/health records per user, and 2,003 timestamped questions (517 multiple-choice and 1,486 short-answer) across IE, MR, TKU, ND, and UA. Evaluation normalizes artifacts to LoCoMo format and uses GPT-5.1-Mini plus text-embedding-3-small, with manual and automatic quality checks.
